cn_title: 林克演员太小没玩《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》
summary: 17岁的Benjamin Evan Ainsworth为真人《塞尔达传说》电影饰演林克，正补完角色与系列历史。他称《旷野之息》2017年推出时自己只有8岁，只能看别人游玩。影片已在新西兰杀青，定档2027年4月30日。
subtitle: 临阵补课

paragraphs.en: Link actor Benjamin Evan Ainsworth has discussed preparing for Nintendo's upcoming live-action The Legend of Zelda movie — and said he was too young to play Breath of the Wild when it originally debuted.
paragraphs.cn: 饰演林克的Benjamin Evan Ainsworth谈到他如何为任天堂即将推出的真人版《塞尔达传说》电影做准备，并称《旷野之息》刚发售时，自己年纪太小，玩不了这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: Ainsworth is currently 17 years old, while Breath of the Wild originally launched for Switch in 2017 — meaning he would have been just eight years old at the time.
paragraphs.cn: Ainsworth目前17岁，而《旷野之息》2017年在Switch推出，这意味着当时他只有8岁。

paragraphs.en: "I remember vividly when Breath of the Wild came out — and it might show my age — but I remember being quite young at the time when it came out, and so I didn't have a Switch at the time," Ainsworth told GamesRadar . "And so, I was watching gamers play it, and watching playthroughs, essentially."
paragraphs.cn: Ainsworth告诉GamesRadar：「我清楚记得《旷野之息》推出时的情景——这或许暴露了我的年龄——但我记得当时自己相当年幼，所以那时没有Switch。所以我就在看玩家玩，也就是看通关流程。」

paragraphs.en: While still a teenager, Ainsworth already has a string of high-profile projects under his belt — such as Netflix horror The Haunting of Bly Manor, CBC sitcom Son of a Critch, and his recent addition to the cast of HBO's House of the Dragon.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管仍是青少年，Ainsworth已经参与过一连串备受瞩目的作品，包括Netflix恐怖剧《鬼庄园》、CBC情景喜剧Son of a Critch，以及最近加入HBO剧集《龙之家族》演员阵容。

paragraphs.en: While Ainsworth may not have played Breath of the Wild a decade ago, the actor has said he's now a Zelda fan has caught himself up on the "history" of the character and series in preparation for his role. (Hopefully Nintendo has given him a Switch 2?)
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Ainsworth十年前可能没玩过《旷野之息》，但这名演员表示，自己如今已是《塞尔达传说》粉丝，并为了演出补上了这名角色和整个系列的「历史」。（希望任天堂已经给他一台Switch 2了？）

paragraphs.en: "Upon being fortunate enough to play this role, such an iconic character, going back and realizing the 40 years of legacy and history, and the varied tones, the varied stories, the varied renditions and vocal performances of this character as well," Ainsworth continued. "Yeah, I'm a big fan, and just really excited, because it was an awesome thing to shoot. New Zealand is a wonderful place. But yeah, can't say too much more."
paragraphs.cn: Ainsworth继续说：「有幸出演如此标志性的角色后，我回溯并认识到它长达40年的传承与历史，以及这个角色多样的基调、故事、不同演绎和配音表现。是的，我是个忠实粉丝，也真的非常兴奋，因为拍摄过程很棒。新西兰是个很美妙的地方。不过，我不能再多说了。」

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has kept many details of its Zelda movie under-wraps, with no word on its story, setting or characters beyond Link and Zelda, the latter of whom will be played by Bo Bragason . Filming in New Zealand has now wrapped , though some fans got a sneaky glimpse — and believe they spotted Succession actress Dichen Lachman in costume as Zelda's aide Impa. Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes director Wes Ball is helming the film, and has spoken previously about wanting to make a "serious" and "grounded" adaptation that feels "real" to audiences .
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂对《塞尔达传说》电影的许多细节仍秘而不宣。除林克和塞尔达外，故事、设定及其他角色均未公布；塞尔达将由Bo Bragason饰演。新西兰的拍摄现已杀青，不过一些粉丝曾悄悄瞥见片场，并认为他们看到了《继承之战》演员Dichen Lachman身着戏服饰演塞尔达的助手英帕。影片由《猩球崛起：新世界》导演Wes Ball执导；他此前说过，希望打造一部让观众感觉「真实」的「严肃」且「扎实」的改编作品。

paragraphs.en: With less than a year to go until the movie's April 30, 2027 launch date, fans expect to hear much more about the film soon — perhaps this fall, when Nintendo gets around to marking the Zelda franchise's 40th anniversary with its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remaster.
paragraphs.cn: 距离电影2027年4月30日上映不足一年，粉丝预计很快会听到更多消息——或许就在今年秋天，届时任天堂将借《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版庆祝《塞尔达传说》系列40周年。

opus_summary: 真人《塞尔达传说》电影林克演员称，《旷野之息》2017年发售时自己仅8岁，只能看别人游玩。影片已在新西兰正式杀青，2027年4月30日上映。
